name: Act II: The Castle
subtitle: Four wings and a heart
brief: The castle hangs off the cliff. Its rooms today are the prototype dungeon (rooms/world.json, eighteen rooms), played whole and unchanged. Around it, the story's frame, all of it from triggers in these act files: a title card entering each wing, a pipe ride the first time you cross between some wings, and when a wing's last stand-in room is solved, its instrument, its boss and what the boss leaves behind. The four wings below say which rooms stand in for them.

scenes.title: The Atrium: the castle's hub
scenes.brief: The front rooms where the wings meet: the Metronome (nothing plays in time until it runs) and Brass 01 to 03. The whole prototype dungeon is walkable from here.
notes: The real hub might be a Mega Man stage select you walk around in: four doors, the Heart sealed in the middle until they are done.
